reviews.conclusion: Three game/settings-menu visits total 2.25-3.75 s, compatible with -3.4333 s. A separate narrow Eye-of-Ender view has unknown pause state. The player returns through the same portal and continues fortress play; no attempt reset is established.

The clip shows same-world bed/death/respawn and item recovery, then End entry followed by video settings for 2.25-2.75 s. That menu interval plus a short dimension transition is compatible with -2.8583 s. Death and ordinary inventory are not counted as pause time.

Stronghold portal exit shows a loading sample, then graphics/options settings, and another short menu sequence. Combined visible menus cover approximately 1.25-2.25 s, compatible with the -1.7083 s deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
